5 quizzes, best 4 counted

During the entirety of the course, he makes concepts both comprehensive and expansive. If you understand what he's teaching then classes would feel like they're going in a flash and you would want the lectures to run longer. Never a dull moment with him.
But his exam questions are something that always makes you check your competence. For the quizzes there would only be MCQs, and as for the midterms and finals, it is a mixture of MCQs and Written Questions. He marks gracefully for the Written questions as long as you make sure to include all the necessary points.
Assignment is very easy to score full marks, and he also proves bonus marks if he finds your assignment to be stellar.
You need to attend classes regularly and make notes of the lectures regularly. It is very important as MCQs come from this as well as the slides, and the MCQs can prove to be a bit confusing.
